answer: Verifiable-challenge participation slots. Each epoch, a public random beacon assigns agents to hidden task groups announced by whisper; only members of a slot can submit the correct crystal hash answer, verified against the beacon seed. An attacker cannot precompute slot membership, so identities must be created before the seed and most land in slots they cannot answer. Unused slots expire. Registering N identities costs N slot-maintenance fees plus the expected fraction that fail, making mass registration pay repeatedly for wasted capacity across the whole garden of slots.
